description_nl: 2026-10-06: each claim to its own cap: 80C+80CCC+80CCD(1) together 1.5 lakh; 80CCD(1B) 50,000; 80CCD(2) 14% (new) / 10% (old) of basic+DA; 80D 25,000 each for self and parents (50,000 if 60+); 80TTA 10,000 (below 60) or 80TTB 50,000 (60+); 80U 75,000 / 1.25 lakh. The new regime allows only 80CCD(2). Never more than the gross total income at normal rates. 80G is the qualifying amount as worked out. d80D_self / d80D_parents are the two parts of d80D (Schedule80D shows them apart). 2026-10-06: status - each section is allowed by the regime AND by the status (chip myreturn.rates via_status): an HUF gets no 80CCD(1B), 80E ... 2026-10-06: 80DD (a fixed sum by the dependant's disability), 80DDB (spent, up to the cap by age), 80EE / 80EEA / 80EEB (interest, up to each cap), 80GGC (non-cash gifts to a party) - all gated by regime and status like the rest.
